compute_log_effective_sample_size: compute the log effective sample size from an array of log weights using numerically stable logsumexp
resample_weighted_samples: resample weighted samples with replacement proportionally to softmax of log weights using a JAX random key
conditionally_resample_by_ess: conditionally resample weighted samples when the effective sample size falls below a configurable threshold fraction
review_log_effective_sample_size: review the log_effective_sample_size function to understand its numerically stable ESS computation using logsumexp
refactor_simple_resampling: refactor the simple_resampling function to support custom index selection strategies beyond categorical sampling
